claims.text: Nutmeg made the Banda Islands so valuable that the Dutch fought to control them.
Cloves, cinnamon and black pepper were not the Banda Islands' famous crop.
Under the 1667 Treaty of Breda the Dutch kept the island of Run in the Banda Islands and the English kept Manhattan.
The English had seized Manhattan from the Dutch and renamed the town New York.
